races.paceDynamic: Alazwar represents the only confirmed front runner in this field of predominantly hold-up horses, meaning he can dictate proceedings without early pressure. Man Is King may provide some early company from his prominent style, but the overwhelming hold-up bias of the field suggests a moderate, uncontested early gallop. This lack of pace pressure will allow the leaders to conserve energy through steady fractions before the field bunches up in the straight. The sustainable pace and cramped finish heavily favours those with tactical speed who can position handy and quicken when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alazwar gets an easy lead with Man Is King settling behind rather than challenging early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian allowing Alazwar to control every call, while the hold-up horses get caught flat-footed when the tempo lifts. Front runners and prominent racers benefit from the soft fractions and positional advantage over a wall of hold-up types.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace creates a bunched field turning for home where tactical speed becomes crucial
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with best recent form and tactical pace find gaps and quicken decisively in the straight melee. Those drawn well and with claims on these ratings capitalize when others get caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If Man Is King tracks Alazwar more aggressively creating slightly stronger fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field more than expected, suiting those who can sit handy and benefit from the honest gallop. Mid-division runners with stamina find the even pace plays to their strengths.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get shuffled back early creating an extreme bunch finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the two-furlong pole with little separating half the field. Those with the best recent sprinting form and luck in running grab the spoils in a photo finish.

watchPoints.text: Alazwar getting a soft uncontested lead could prove decisive given the lack of other front runners
Pay Attention and Never Dream both return from 230+ day absences which raises major fitness concerns
Man Is King's early positioning will be crucial - whether he challenges Alazwar or settles behind
The amateur jockey factor could cause traffic problems in a bunched finish with so many hold-up horses
Romanovich's recent win and consistency makes him the danger if the pace sets up right for hold-up types

runners_data.name: Angel Shared

runners_data.name: Fidelius

runners_data.comment: Better than ever on AW in recent times; 0-8 on turf and has a career-high mark to overcome
runners_data.spotlight: 6-17 on AW and better than ever this spring, following his Lingfield win in March with a narrow defeat at Southwell; 0-8 on turf but has run well on fast ground in the past; perhaps a shade high in the weights now.

runners_data.name: Ruby's Profit
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner wearing headgear who should lead but recent 29-day break may blunt sharpness.

runners_data.name: Marty Hopkirk
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits race shape perfectly with trainer David Loughnane maintaining decent strike rate.

runners_data.name: Sturlasson
runners_data.note: Handy prominent runner but trainer John Ryan currently without winners from eight recent attempts.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared will contest the early lead in this sprint, with Ruby's Profit's recent Lingfield form suggesting stronger pace-forcing ability. The dual front-runners should create an honest gallop over 5f at Bath, with prominent runners Regal Envoy, Fidelius, Marty Hopkirk and Sturlasson tracking just behind. Hold-up horses Moulin Booj and Desert Cop will need the pace to collapse late to be effective over this minimum trip. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can sit close to the pace without being drawn into the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared engage in a prolonged speed duel from the gates.
scenarios.body: The two leaders will weaken each other allowing the prominent runners tracking them to sweep past in the final furlong. Fidelius and Regal Envoy are perfectly positioned to capitalise on their superior tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Profit or Angel Shared establishes a clear advantage and dictates terms solo.
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls the pace and has enough left to repel late challenges over this sharp 5f trip. Their tactical advantage proves decisive against closers who lack time to make ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Collapse Allows Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners tie up dramatically in the final half-furlong.
scenarios.body: The severe pace collapse gives the hold-up horses rare opportunities to showcase their finishing kicks. Moulin Booj's recent course form becomes crucial in this late-developing scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Mid-Race Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If early pace setbacks cause bunching and traffic problems in the middle stages.
scenarios.body: Poor positioning and interference will randomly eliminate several contenders from winning chances. The race becomes a lottery favouring horses drawn away from trouble with clearest runs.

watchPoints.text: Ruby's Profit could set unsustainable fractions if determined to make all and compromise winning chances.
Fidelius making turf debut after excellent AW form may not handle surface switch effectively.
Desert Cop and Moulin Booj need significant pace collapse to be competitive over this sharp 5f trip.
Regal Envoy retaining headgear suggests connections expect another forward showing after recent Bath third.
Angel Shared's early positioning crucial to avoid being drawn into pace battle with Ruby's Profit.

runners_data.name: Toolatetonegotiate

runners_data.name: Smooth Silesie
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who gets the race run to suit as the lone pace-setter, though form is patchy.

runners_data.name: Diomed Spirit

runners_data.name: Tees Aggregates

races.paceDynamic: Smooth Silesie will take this race forward as the sole confirmed front runner, with Over Spiced likely to sit in behind in second as a prominent racer. The majority of the field - Aces Wild, Toolatetonegotiate, Diomed Spirit, and Tees Aggregates - are hold-up horses who will be bunched together in rear. With one leader setting an uncontested pace followed by four closers, this creates a steady gallop that should suit the front two horses who can control the tempo. This race shape strongly favours the early pace, particularly the leader and prominent racers who can dictate terms without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie jumps well and settles into an easy rhythm without pressure from behind
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner controls the pace completely and proves too strong for the hold-up brigade who face a wall of horses when making their moves. Over Spiced can track the leader and potentially challenge, but the tactical advantage lies with those racing handy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent challenger strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Over Spiced settles better than at Nottingham and travels strongly behind the leader
scenarios.body: The Grace Harris filly can use her proven 5f speed to strike from second position, benefiting from the perfect trip behind Smooth Silesie. Her three wins at this distance last year show she has the class to capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse finds gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly sedate and the closers can find racing room in the straight
scenarios.body: One of the quartet of hold-up horses manages to weave through traffic and uses superior closing speed to overhaul the leaders. Aces Wild and Toolatetonegotiate have the best recent form to mount such a challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The entire complexion changes with all six horses in contention turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish. The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario but this seems unlikely given the specific pace dynamic.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Over Spiced settles kindly early rather than racing keenly as she did at Nottingham last month
Monitor whether Smooth Silesie gets away cleanly from the stalls to secure the uncontested lead
Check if any of the hold-up horses can secure prominent early positions to change the pace dynamic
Observe whether the pace becomes genuinely strong or remains the expected steady gallop
Watch for traffic problems affecting the quartet of hold-up horses bunched at the rear

races.paceDynamic: Sands Of Seve will take the race along from the front with Takincareofbizness, Cougar Force, and Rogue Rebellion tracking prominently behind. The pace should be genuine but not breakneck over 5½f at Bath, with the single confirmed leader not facing immediate pressure from the gate. The race sets up for horses that can position handily and have a turn of foot, as the strong pace will expose pure hold-up merchants who rely on others weakening. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can avoid getting too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Sands Of Seve maintains a solid gallop without folding and the prominent horses stay competitive
scenarios.body: The pace proves testing enough to string out the field but sustainable for those close to it. Hold-up horses struggle to make meaningful late progress as the race doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Sands Of Seve goes too hard early or the prominent trackers apply excessive pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the leaders fold in the final furlong, opening the door for closers. Late runners with stamina reserves capitalize as the race falls apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and the race becomes more tactical than expected
scenarios.body: Without significant early pressure, horses with a sharp turn of foot can position perfectly and outkick rivals. Those with tactical pace who can quicken sharply hold the advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sands Of Seve Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the Robert Cowell-trained leader gets an uncontested lead and stays strong
scenarios.body: With no pressure applied early, Sands Of Seve controls the race from pillar to post and has enough left to repel late challenges. The race becomes a procession with the leader setting his own fractions.

watchPoints.text: Sands Of Seve breaking slowly could disrupt the entire pace dynamic as the designated front-runner
Takincareofbizness getting shuffled back from his prominent position would eliminate a key contender
Miss Magic Dragon's early positioning will reveal her true running style and tactical approach
Rogue Rebellion's jockey Kieran O'Neill being too aggressive early could compromise his finishing kick
The gap between leaders and hold-up horses at halfway will indicate whether late runners have any chance

races.paceDynamic: Mrembo looks the only confirmed early leader in a field dominated by hold-up horses, with Bobby Dassler the only other prominent runner. This creates a tactical dream for Mrembo to dictate terms without pressure through steady fractions on good to firm ground that should suit her prominent style. With seven of nine runners preferring to come from behind, including Virtual Hug, Beaune, and Two Plus Two, the pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mrembo Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Mrembo breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from Bobby Dassler
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to pass with most rivals needing to come from too far back. The lack of pace pressure plays directly into her hands despite being held up by a 5lb claimer.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses get bunched up turning for home
scenarios.body: Several runners with winning chances get hampered while one or two get clear runs to exploit the slow pace. The tactical disadvantage of so many similar styles creates opportunities for those who get racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bobby Dassler Forces Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Bobby Dassler challenges Mrembo early and creates genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The stronger pace brings the hold-up horses into play, particularly those with proven stamina like Two Plus Two returning from a long break. Mrembo's fitness edge gets negated by a harder race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Mrembo and Bobby Dassler fail to go forward as expected
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling affair that turns into a pure sprint finish where class and acceleration matter most. Beaune's recent AW form could translate despite turf struggles.

watchPoints.text: Mrembo must break alertly and go forward early as any hesitation allows the field to bunch up and negates her tactical advantage.
Bobby Dassler's tactics are crucial - if he stays back rather than pressing Mrembo, the pace will be pedestrian throughout.
Virtual Hug's turf record is poor but his recent hurdle win suggests he retains ability if able to transfer AW form.
Traffic problems are inevitable turning for home with seven hold-up horses needing room simultaneously in the straight.
Two Plus Two's long absence raises fitness concerns but his class and course form make him dangerous if others set it up.

races.paceDynamic: Alice's Influence will be the lone confirmed leader and can dictate terms from the front in this 10-runner field. With only Shes Got The Blues likely to race prominently, Alice's Influence faces minimal early pressure and can control fractions through the first half-mile. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses (Henfield, Lady Of Clover, Sail On Sailor, Grand Echo, Resalah, Marveling, Pam's Sonnet, Mali Star) who will be bunched together off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the front-running profile, as Alice's Influence can steal crucial lengths while the hold-up brigade fights for racing room in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Alice's Influence Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alice's Influence gets uncontested fractions and maintains her recent winning form.
scenarios.body: She can open up decisive lengths turning for home while the hold-up horses encounter traffic problems behind her. Her proven ability at this trip on good ground makes her the primary beneficiary of this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the hold-up horses get clear runs in the straight.
scenarios.body: Lady Of Clover and Mali Star, both showing recent improvement, can unleash strong finishing kicks from off the pace. Their superior RPR figures give them the class edge if they get racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenger Success
scenarios.trigger: If Shes Got The Blues can press Alice's Influence and outlast her in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The Tony Carroll-trained filly has been running consistently in defeat and her prominent style could pay dividends if she can make Alice's Influence work harder early. Her recent third at this level suggests she's capable of winning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite falters and an improving type like Marveling finds significant improvement stepping up in trip.
scenarios.body: Marveling is making her handicap debut after modest maiden efforts over 7f, and the step up to 1m could unlock untapped potential. If the market speaks in her favour, she could outrun her odds at a big price.

watchPoints.text: Alice's Influence must be monitored closely in the betting - any significant drift would suggest stable confidence has waned after her quick reappearance.
Lady Of Clover and Mali Star need clear passages in the straight as both rely on strong finishing kicks from off the pace.
Marveling represents the stable making their seasonal debut and any market support would be highly significant for this handicap newcomer.
The good to firm going may be faster than ideal for several runners who have shown best form on softer surfaces.
Pat Cosgrave's presence on Alice's Influence adds tactical expertise to execute the front-running strategy effectively.
